setting: an early medieval town of the Venetian lagoon, built on low islands of mud and reed
route: Each dark band becomes a route that people walk along: a quay paved in pale Istrian stone or a broad timber boardwalk where it runs on land, and a stone or timber bridge wherever it crosses water. A route is never water itself.
ground: Paint a shallow teal-green lagoon seen in clear morning light, with low islands of mud, grass and reed under the routes; narrow canals divide the islands and open water with pale sandbanks and reed beds surrounds them. Wherever a route crosses a canal it is carried on a bridge.
fill: Fill the islands with close-packed brick and timber houses with weathered tile roofs, small paved squares with wellheads, kitchen gardens, boats moored along the canals (never on a route), and salt pans and fishing stakes out in the shallows. Do not fall back on a generic mainland town with fields.

winery.label: glassworks
winery.landmark: a glassworks: a brick workshop with smoking furnace chimneys and stacks of firewood, on its own small island

northwest library.label: abbey library
northwest library.landmark: a monastery with a cloister and a library, where records are kept

temple library.label: scriptorium
temple library.landmark: a scriptorium beside the basilica: a stone hall where records are copied and kept

temple.label: basilica
temple.landmark: the seat of power: a great domed basilica with a colonnaded front and a tall brick bell tower, the grandest place in the picture

proposer P.label: palazzo
proposer P.landmark: a merchant's palazzo with arcaded loggias, marked by one strong blue feature: blue awnings and a long blue banner

crossroads.label: campo
crossroads.landmark: an open paved square where the routes meet, with one carved stone wellhead as its centrepiece; travellers arrive here

pottery.label: cooperage
pottery.landmark: a cooper's yard: an open-sided workshop surrounded by stacked barrels and staves

proposer Q.label: palazzo
proposer Q.landmark: a rival merchant's palazzo of the same size and style as the blue one, marked by one strong red feature: red awnings and a long red banner

fishery.label: fish market
fishery.landmark: a fish market on a quay: a long open timber hall with nets drying on racks and fishing boats moored beside it

southeast library.label: notary's archive
southeast library.landmark: a notary's archive: a sturdy stone tower house where contracts and records are kept

granary.label: salt works
granary.landmark: a salt works: brick storehouses with white heaps of salt, beside shallow rectangular evaporation pans
